method: Actual production app; native vertical/horizontal scrolling, fonts and decoded visible images. Animations are allowed to run naturally without seeking or screenshot-only DOM/style replacements. Section crops use real full-page pixels.
limitations: Chromium/Linux viewport and touch emulation only; physical Safari/iPad not tested.

Default captures show a natural frame of the running marquee and its default controls; viewport and full-page captures may record different animation phases. Continuous behavior is verified separately.
Photographic fidelity requires manual reference review.
